jobs.title: German speaking Junior Key Account Manager
jobs.description:
Are you ready to take the next step in your career and grow into a strategic client-facing role? We’re looking for a driven and communicative  Junior Key Account Manager  to support our client relationships and help shape the future of our business.
This is a great opportunity for someone with  2-5 years of experience in a sales role in banking , who has completed a  university degree  or  banking graduate program , and is fluent in  German, Swiss German and English .
Your Role:
As a Junior Key Account Manager, you’ll work closely with senior colleagues to support and grow key client relationships. You’ll help prepare client meetings, ensure smooth coordination across departments, and actively contribute to building long-term partnerships.
Your key tasks

• Manage customer relationships in the Swiss German speaking region

• Assist in managing and developing key client accounts

• Prepare client presentations, proposals, and reports

• Identify, shape and present sales pitches

• Collaborate across teams to ensure excellent client service

• Identify opportunities for account growth and improvement

• Support client meetings and manage follow-up actions

• Maintain accurate client records and CRM data

## Qualifiche

• 2+ years of relevant experience in  b2b and/or b2c banking   sales ,  client support , and  banking

• Completed  university degree  or  banking graduate program

• Native in German or Swiss German and fluent in English

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills

• Organized, reliable, and eager to learn

• Ability to adapt in a fast-paced, client-focused environment

• Strong understanding of sales approaches

• Willingness to take responsibility for high value sales cases and drive sales success

• Strong sales performance incentives provided

## Informazioni aggiuntive

In Avaloq we are proud to embrace diversity and understand the success of our business is built on the power of different opinions, we are whole heartedly committed to fostering an equal opportunity environment and inclusive culture where you can be your true authentic self.
We hire, compensate and promote regardless of origin, age, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other fantastic traits that make us all unique, we have done our best to write this advert in an inclusive and neutral way.
Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations.

jobs.title: Senior Cyber Security Specialist
jobs.description:
We are looking for an individual with a passion for cyber security to work alongside a talented team to Improve and operate a cyber security Center.
The role requires a strong background and understanding of all cyber security domains.
In this position, you will be part of the global cyber security operations team with focus on identification, analysis and response to cyber security threats and events. You will support the Head of our Cyber Security Operations Center in improving the effectiveness of the team and Leads the planning, implementation, documentation.
You can expect a demanding and complex international environment, which is highly stimulating and encouraging. The growth of the company demands your structured and innovative approach, as well as flexibility to a high degree. As a committed team player, you will support developing the maturity of the cyber security operation center, its controls and processes.
Your key tasks

• Handle daily incidents/threats

• Assist correlating alerts, implementing monitoring Use Cases

• Recommend Cyber Security changes or enhancements and drive implementation

• Manage and cultivate the defined security services and the relationship to our service providers

• Participate in organizational Security projects, as required

• Support in development processes, and procedures for the team

• Provide implementations, recommendations for protecting and resolving threats and incidents

• Participate in the selection and evaluation of security solutions, or enhancements to existing cyber security solutions, to improve overall enterprise security

• Manage and support in major Cyber Security Incidents

• Support in on-call rotation

• Act as a technical Lead role model in the team on driving initiatives and projects

## Qualifiche

• 4-6 years of working experience in a SOC / CDC or similar roles

• Working experience in the creation of playbooks and the tuning of SIEM use cases

• Deep knowledge and expertise in SIEM and EDR solutions

• Solid knowledge about Cloud like (AWS, Azure, Oracle etc)

• Working experience in Threat Intelligence Management

• Fluent in English (both written and verbal)

• Knowledge of German is considered a strong asset
It would be a real bonus if you have

• Information and Cyber Security certificates like CISSP, SANS or similar

• Working experience with Splunk Apps, especially Enterprise Security and knowledge of the Splunk “search”-language

• Working experience with automation and SOAR solutions

• Working experience in Digital Forensics and Cyber Security Incident Response

## Informazioni aggiuntive

We realize that managing work life balance is a challenge we all face in our daily lives and in order to support with this we are pleased to offer hybrid and flexible working for most of our Avaloqers to maintain work life balance and still continue our fantastic Avaloq culture in our global offices.

jobs.description:
Avaloq is seeking an experienced Technical Solution Consultant to join the Global Solutions Consulting organisation.

The role is responsible for end‑to‑end solution design, commercial support and RFP/RFI execution for complex banking opportunities across private banking, wealth management and universal banking clients.
The successful candidate will act as a trusted technical and solution advisor to clients and internal stakeholders, owning solution integrity across functional, technical, commercial and delivery dimensions.
Your key tasks
Sales & Client Engagement

• Act as a customer‑facing solution authority supporting Avaloq sales opportunities primarily within Europe and North America.  Involvement in other regions may be necessary when requried.

• Lead or contribute to client workshops, solution presentations and due‑diligence sessions, both remote and on‑site.

• Translate client business, regulatory and IT requirements into viable Avaloq‑based solution architectures.

• Act as a trusted advisor for senior client stakeholders, including CIO, COO, Head of Operations and Enterprise Architecture.
RFP, RFI & Deal Support

• Manage and deliver RFP / RFI / Technical Questionnaire responses with high quality, consistency and regulatory defensibility.

• Own solution positioning, differentiators and assumptions, ensuring clarity between standard, configurable and custom capabilities.

• Prepare deal gate material (solution scope, complexity, risks, assumptions, cost drivers) in alignment with Sales and Delivery.

• Ensure all solution proposals comply with Avaloq commercial, legal, risk and governance frameworks.
Solution Architecture & Design

• Design end‑to‑end solutions covering:
• Avaloq Core Platform (ACP)

• Digital Channels (Web / RM Workplace)

• Community API, integration and messaging patterns

• Data, analytics, reporting and regulatory tooling

• Hosting models: SaaS, BPaaS, managed services, on‑premises / client‑hosted

• Define non‑functional requirements including:
• Security, IAM, data protection and regulatory compliance

• High availability, DR, performance and scalability

• Operational model, support and change processes

• Partner closely with Delivery, Product Management, Hosting and Security teams to ensure solution feasibility and integrity.
Internal Stakeholder Management

• Act as primary solution Point-of-Contact for internal deal‑making teams, coordinating input from Product, Architecture, Security, Legal and Delivery.

• Manage internal alignments, reviews and approvals, ensuring auditability and traceability of decisions.

• Follow and enforce internal processes, governance and handover disciplines to Delivery.

## Qualifiche

Domain & Industry

• Strong experience in private banking, wealth management or financial services IT.

• Solid understanding of banking operations, regulatory environments (e.g. FINMA, ECB, MAS, FCA) and IT controls.
Technology Expertise
The candidate must demonstrate hands‑on experience with technologies commonly used within Avaloq solutions, including:

• Core banking platforms (Avaloq or comparable tier‑1 systems)

• API‑based integration, messaging and event‑driven architectures

• Digital banking channels and client‑facing platforms

• Cloud and hosting concepts (OCI, AWS, Azure, hybrid models)

• Strong understanding of Kubernetes including:
• Container orchestration concepts, networking and security

• High availability, resilience and scaling patterns

• Operational concerns: monitoring, logging, upgrades and lifecycle management

• Experience positioning and designing solutions running on:
• Managed Kubernetes services (e.g. OpenShift, EKS, AKS or equivalent)

• Hybrid or on‑premises Kubernetes environments

• Ability to articulate Kubernetes value propositions, risks and operational implications clearly to clients and non‑technical stakeholders.

• Security architecture, IAM, data protection and compliance controls

• Infrastructure sizing, performance and high‑availability design

• Modern enterprise technologies (Kubernetes, containerisation, observability, CI/CD)
Professional Skills

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, suitable for C‑suite, regulators and client decision‑makers.

• Strong presentation and storytelling ability, translating complexity into clear, defensible narratives.

• Proven ability to manage multiple parallel engagements under time pressure.

• High level of autonomy, accountability and professionalism.

• Ability to operate confidently in ambiguous, high‑stakes deal environments.
Education & Experience

• Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or equivalent experience.

• Typically 7–10+ years experience in solution consulting, pre‑sales or architecture roles.

• Prior experience working in international, matrix‑organised environments is strongly preferred.
Language & Cultural Capability

• Fluent English is mandatory; additional European languages are strongly preferred, particularly:
• German (highly desirable for Swiss and DACH clients)

• French (Switzerland / France / Benelux)

• Italian or Spanish (southern Europe coverage)

• Ability to operate comfortably in multilingual, multicultural client environments, including adapting communication style for different regions.

• Experience working with regulated European financial institutions is a strong advantage.

## Informazioni aggiuntive

We realize that managing work life balance is a challenge we all face in our daily lives and in order to support with this we are pleased to offer hybrid and flexible working for most of our Avaloqers to maintain work life balance and still continue our fantastic Avaloq culture in our global offices.
In Avaloq we are proud to embrace diversity and understand the success of our business is built on the power of different opinions, we are whole heartedly committed to fostering an equal opportunity environment and inclusive culture where you can be your true authentic self.
We hire, compensate and promote regardless of origin, age, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other fantastic traits that make us all unique, we have done our best to write this advert in an inclusive and neutral way.
Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations.

• Integrazione basata su API, messaggistica e architetture basate su eventi
• Canali bancari digitali e piattaforme client
• Concetti cloud e hosting (OCI, AWS, Azure, modelli ibridi)
• Forte comprensione dei Kuberneti, tra cui:
• Concetti di orchestrazione del contenitore, rete e sicurezza
• Alta disponibilità, resistenza e modelli di scaling
• Problemi operativi: monitoraggio, registrazione, aggiornamenti e gestione del ciclo di vita

• Servizi gestiti Kubernetes (ad esempio OpenShift, EKS, AKS o equivalente)
• ambienti Kubernetes ibridi o on-premise
• Capacità di articolare le proposizioni di valore Kubernetes, i rischi e le implicazioni operative chiaramente ai clienti e agli stakeholder non tecnici.
• Architettura di sicurezza, IAM, protezione dei dati e controlli di conformità
• Infrastrutture dimensionamento, performance e design ad alta disponibilità
• Tecnologie aziendali moderne (Kubernetes, containerizzazione, osservabilità, CI/CD) Abilità professionali
• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione scritta e verbale, adatto per C‐suite, regolatori e decisori dei clienti.
• Forte capacità di presentazione e storytelling, traducendo la complessità in narrazioni chiare e defensibili.
• Prove capacità di gestire più impegni paralleli sotto pressione temporale.
• Alto livello di autonomia, responsabilità e professionalità.
• Capacità di operare con fiducia in ambienti ambigui e di alto livello. Istruzione e esperienza
• Laurea in Informatica, Ingegneria, Sistemi Informativi o esperienza equivalente.
• Tipicamente 7–10+ anni di esperienza nella consulenza di soluzioni, pre-vendita o ruoli di architettura.
• L'esperienza precedente che lavora in ambienti internazionali, organizzati a matrice è fortemente preferita. Capacità linguistica e culturale
• L'inglese fluido è obbligatorio; le lingue europee aggiuntive sono fortemente preferite, in particolare:
• Tedesco (altamente auspicabile per i clienti svizzeri e DACH)
• Francese (Svizzera / Francia / Benelux)
• Italiano o Spagnolo (copertura Europa meridionale)
• Capacità di operare comodamente in ambienti client plurilingui e multiculturali, anche adattando lo stile di comunicazione per diverse regioni.
• L'esperienza di lavoro con istituzioni finanziarie europee regolamentate è un forte vantaggio. The Test Management Team is accountable to manage the various test campaigns in the context of the maintenance of the application landscape of our clients during SIT (System Integration Test – internally) and UAT (User Acceptance Test – with the client) phases.

• Manage client acceptance environment usage plan across projects and AMS for each client

• Orchestrate installation of bug fixes with Development and Release Management

jobs.description:

• Monitor platform health, troubleshoot issues, and provide  L2/L3 support

• Maintain technical documentation, SOPs, and runbooks aligned with audit and compliance requirements

jobs.description:
We are looking for a hands-on security engineer to take end-to-end ownership of our Cloud Security & Cryptographic Services and Network Security domains. You will shape how these services are delivered across cloud and hybrid-cloud environments - setting direction, driving adoption, and ensuring operational quality - while also contributing directly to implementation, automation, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement (this is not a purely coordinating role).
Your key tasks

• Own and continuously improve the Cloud & Network Security service scope, including:
• Cloud security posture and guardrails (secure-by-default baselines, policies, zones/guardrails)

• Cloud detection and response controls (configuration, tuning, integrations, signal quality)

• Cryptographic services (keys, certificates, secrets, API keys: lifecycle, rotation, revocation, access governance, compliance evidence)

• Network security posture and governance (firewalls, proxies, IDS/IPS, Cloudflare-based services, NSGs/security lists)

• Run a sustainable network rule governance model (inventory, periodic re-accreditation/recertification, exception handling, audit readiness)

• Drive automation-first operations : monitoring, metrics, alerting, playbooks, inventory automation, configuration validation, and drift prevention

• Translate stakeholder needs into clear standards, backlogs, and delivery priorities - and ensure adoption with minimal friction for engineering teams

• Actively contribute hands-on: configuration changes, scripting/automation, troubleshooting, and incident/on-call support when needed
This role can be based in Zurich or Bioggio.

• Strong experience in cloud security and network security in enterprise environments (ideally regulated/financial industry)

• Practical experience with cryptography / PKI / key and secrets management (lifecycle, access control, rotation, auditability)

• Hands-on engineering mindset (configuration work, troubleshooting, automation)

• Ability to manage a backlog/roadmap and align stakeholders, while staying pragmatic and delivery-focused

As the Head of Reporting for Sales and Delivery, you are accountable for the integrity, consistency and transparency of performance reporting across Sales and Project portfolios. You own the reporting frameworks, data governance standards and analytics architecture that enable reliable, decision-ready insights.
You will lead a team of professionals and drive the evolution of our reporting landscape, ensuring that data, tools and processes are structured to maximize analytical value. This is a strategic leadership role focused on translating complex data into actionable insights and enabling confident, data-driven decision-making at senior leadership level.

• Deliver executive-level performance visibility by preparing and consolidating reporting for senior stakeholders (e.g. GEB, NEC), ensuring clarity, consistency and comparability of insights

• Lead performance review cadences, including Quarterly Review Sessions, providing structured analysis of performance against KPIs, trends and risks

• Act as a strategic advisor to business leaders, translating data into actionable insights to support operational performance and decision-making

• Lead and develop a high-performing team, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement

• Drive the design and optimization of reporting tools and data models to enable scalable analytics and improved data accessibility

• Build strong cross-functional relationships, aligning reporting structures with business needs and ensuring adoption of governance standards through training and stakeholder engagement

• Create one version of the truth across Sales and Delivery

• Turn reporting from a retrospective activity into a decision engine

• Establish clear governance without slowing down the business

• Proven experience in a senior reporting, analytics, or performance management role, ideally within Sales, Delivery, or a comparable commercial environment

You will lead a high-performing multi-country team of 20+, overseeing everything from rigorous bottom-up budgeting to high-level strategic long-range planning and daily controllership for our departments. You will be the CFO’s right hand, ensuring that our financial steering, business partnering, and controlling functions align perfectly with our growth targets.
Key tasks:
Strategic financial planning & analysis

• Lead the development of long-term financial strategies and 3–5 year models that support global expansion and capital allocation in line with our mid-term plan aspirations.

• Conduct sophisticated "what-if" analyses and risk assessments to evaluate potential business outcomes and provide strategic recommendations to senior leadership.

• Analyze industry trends and the competitive landscape to shape effective strategies and establish market standard KPIs to track organizational success.
Advanced controlling & reporting

• Define and oversee our financial steering model and drive finance-related performance management, systematically assessing outcomes and improvement measures.

• Partner with accounting teams to ensure accurate information flow and implement reporting processes that enhance financial transparency across the organization.

• Deep-dive into financial data to identify trends, pinpoint variances, and provide the "narrative" behind the numbers to stakeholders.
Budgeting & cost management

• Establish clear budget guidelines and monitor performance against forecasts to identify areas for cost savings and operational efficiencies

• Implement rigorous cost control methodologies, assessing how cost changes affect profitability and collaborating with department heads to manage key cost drivers.

• Review and approve budget requests based on strategic priorities, ensuring any money spent aligns with organizational goals.
Leadership & business partnering

• Lead and scale a diverse team, fostering a collaborative environment through regular performance evaluations, constructive feedback, and professional development.

• Act as a strategic consultant to business leaders, providing the financial insights necessary to enhance operational performance and decision-making.

• Build strong relationships across the firm, facilitating workshops and training sessions for non-financial managers to synchronize financial goals with operational plans.

• Collaborate with IT and project team to modernize our ERP systems and financial information tools, ensuring the team has the best-in-class cloud-based tech stack for financial management.

## Qualifiche

• 12+ years of senior finance experience, including 5+ years in FP&A and a minimum of 3+ years in a senior leadership role managing teams.

• Evidencible proficiency in advanced financial modelling, forecasting, and cost analysis, with strong mastery of ERP systems, financial reporting software, and data visualisation tools.

• Strong proficiency in financial modelling, forecasting and cost analysis and expert experience of working with ERP systems, financial reporting software, and data visualisation tools.

• Proven capability to set enterprise-level goals and strategies within complex environments.

Project Management excellence

• Establish a robust project management structure for Finance. Implement industry-standard methodologies to ensure consistent delivery across the portfolio.

Au-delà de la consolidation et de l'avancement du PGI, vous dirigerez d'autres initiatives stratégiques essentielles au succès global d'Avaloq. Tâches clés : Excellence en gestion de projet
• Mettre en place une solide structure de gestion des projets pour les finances. Mettre en oeuvre des méthodes normalisées pour assurer une prestation uniforme dans l'ensemble du portefeuille.
• Élaborer des plans de projet détaillés pour s'assurer que toutes les étapes sont respectées dans les délais et dans les limites du budget. Suivre le rendement, mettre en oeuvre des mesures correctives et effectuer des évaluations rigoureuses après le projet.
• Exécution indépendante de projets clés avec une équipe mondiale et une allocation optimisée des ressources, toujours en meilleure qualité, temps et budget
• Architecte et dirige le cycle de vie de bout en bout du projet pour consolider deux systèmes sur site en une solution unique et cohérente basée sur le cloud. L'agent de changement: Modernité et efficacité
• Agir en tant qu'agent de changement inlassable, menant la fonction Finance par les contraintes héritées et dans un environnement numérique moderne, automatisé et évolutif.
• Championne le principe de "simplification d'abord". Avant d'automatiser, vous allez défier les complexités existantes pour nous assurer de construire des processus simples et efficaces plutôt que de simplement numériser les anciens.
• Veiller à ce que les nouveaux systèmes fournissent des informations en temps réel, ce qui permettra au ministère des Finances d'agir comme conseiller stratégique auprès de l'ensemble des entreprises.
• Favoriser une culture au sein de l'organisation financière qui englobe la technologie standard de l'industrie et l'amélioration continue. Leadership et engagement des parties prenantes
• Diriger et encadrer l'équipe des projets stratégiques pour stimuler la performance et la croissance professionnelle; encourager la réflexion novatrice et la résolution de problèmes au sein de l'organisation financière.
• Cultiver des relations solides avec les principales parties prenantes, recueillir des commentaires et diriger des réunions pour promouvoir la transparence et fixer des attentes claires.
• Élaborer et exécuter des plans de communication pour maintenir l'organisation engagée et assurer la formation afin d'assurer l'adoption sans heurt de nouveaux systèmes. Qualifiche
• Forte expérience de travail dans un rôle similaire, idéalement au sein d'un fournisseur de logiciels bancaires
• Vous aurez une solide expérience des plateformes ERP, par exemple SAP, y compris les implémentations, les mises à niveau et les modules financiers.
• Forte capacité éprouvée de diriger des projets interfonctionnels complexes où vous gérez les échéanciers, le budget, les risques et l'engagement des parties prenantes en utilisant votre communication fantastique et moteur.
• Vous aurez la preuve de mener au moins une migration complète ERP vers le cloud pour le cycle de vie complet du projet.
• Vous aurez de solides capacités de réflexion conceptuelle et serez compétent dans l'analyse et la visualisation des données, mais également capable d'expliquer ces concepts complexes d'une manière facile à comprendre à ceux qui ne le savent pas.
